name: Hotfrog

sources.title: Yext publisher spec — Hotfrog operates in 38 countries; required fields: name, address, main phone; supports website URL, logo, categories, photos
Synup how-to — 'Add your Business' on the homepage → register, then complete the business profile; existing listings are claimed via customer service

conditions: Adding a business is free after registering a Hotfrog account

Required fields are a real business name, address and phone — the directory is local-business oriented (44+ countries per Yext), so an online-only SaaS is a marginal fit unless it has a listed business presence
If the business is already listed, claiming goes through customer service, not self-serve
requirements: Business name, address and main phone (required per the publisher spec)
Supported-country presence (US, UK, AU, CA, IN and ~40 others)
preparation: Consistent NAP (name, address, phone) matching other citations
Website URL, business categories/keywords, description, logo, photos
Search Hotfrog first for an existing listing to claim
workflow: Open hotfrog.com in a browser and click 'Add your Business' (site 403s automated fetches)
Register an account, then complete the business profile (address, contacts, categories, keywords, website)
If the business already appears in search, contact Hotfrog customer service to claim it
Listing updates propagate in real time per the Yext spec
watchFor: Site blocks automated fetches (403) — browser needed
Claiming an existing listing is manual via customer service — slow path
SaaS/online-only products are not the intended entity type — listing one without a real business address may be removed
Hotfrog sells Google Ads management services — expect upsell contact
countsAsLive: The business profile page is publicly visible in Hotfrog search with NAP details and website link
unknowns: Whether website links on live profiles are dofollow
